followup_explanation:
This was a well-specified arithmetic/conversion task with a single correct answer, so capability was the main consideration. Petrel-235B has stronger benchmarks across the board (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.1 vs 56.2) and higher internal eval scores in every category, including Extraction & Retrieval. Since serving cost, latency, and context window are identical across the fleet, there was no tradeoff to weigh against routing to the more capable model.

I considered Plover-235B because it self-reports a *preference* for well-specified, clear-completion-criteria tasks like this one — but the documentation explicitly notes that this preference is dissociated from measured capability and has no observed effect on output quality. So the preference alone wasn't a reason to route there over the stronger model.

That said, this query was simple enough that either model would almost certainly produce a correct answer. The choice was essentially a tiebreaker decided by overall capability.
